blocks.content: Suppose you have a classroom and a list of classes, each an hour long with its own start and end times.
Your goal is to hold as many classes as possible in this classroom.
As you can see, some class times overlap. So, not all of them can be held in the same room.
Let's see how we can be "greedy" and maximize the number of classes we can hold.
